summary: Verified the payout 0% bugfix on /demo-trade against the user's VPS backend. Registered a fresh trader on api.binaryfundglobal.com (no 2FA on register), seeded bfg_token/bfg_user in localStorage, then reloaded the page 6 times (1 cold with bfg_payouts cleared, 5 warm) sampling the desktop payout chip [data-testid=trade-panel-payout-chip] and the big payout [data-testid=trade-profit-pct] 25 times every 200ms per reload. Also verified asset-tab switching, AssetPicker payout rows, symbol-to-symbol consistency, and code-reviewed the backend _settle_one live-payout change.

realtime_admin_change_test: NOT executed end-to-end. No VPS admin credentials are available, so we cannot mutate the payout table server-side. Code review of the client realtime path confirms it works: DemoTrade.jsx socket handler 'markets/payouts' (lines 193-201) merges the new table into a dedicated setPayouts state and updates localStorage; instrumentList (lines 271-273) derives payout from payouts[symbol] at every render, so any admin change delivered on the socket flows straight through to TradePanel and AssetPicker without a reload. No further FE work needed.
regression_checks: Not re-tested in this iteration — iterations 51-54 already covered chart jump-to-live, no live right-drift, no snap-back on pan-left, price-axis shrink-only + ns-resize cursor, candle countdown above drawing lines, tab-return refetch, no asset-tab lock icon. No new JS console errors observed on the /demo-trade page during this run (only a benign 'Not connected to trading server' would fire if socket was down — did not occur).

details: engine.meta.get(order.symbol, {}).get('payout') is used to read the live admin payout at settlement time (line 30).

Decimal-safe: value is wrapped with Decimal(str(live_payout)) before any arithmetic (line 31); falls back to order.payout_pct (already Decimal) when the symbol is missing from engine.meta or its payout is None.
Persistence: if the live payout differs from the stored one, order.payout_pct is overwritten so the closed trade record shows the payout actually applied (lines 32-33). Good for auditability.

Profit math unchanged: won -> stake * payout / 100 (quantized to cents), lost -> -stake, refunded -> 0. All three branches use the same 'payout' variable, so the live value is correctly applied only in the 'won' branch (payout is irrelevant to lost/refund math), which is the desired behaviour.
Nit (non-blocking): if engine.meta[symbol].payout is stored as int/float, Decimal(str(...)) is fine; if ever stored as Decimal, str() round-trip is still safe. No precision loss.

critical_code_review_comments: DemoTrade.jsx: payouts state + localStorage cache + render-time merge is the right pattern. Consider also merging cached payouts BEFORE the HTTP /instruments response resolves so the TradeSkeleton could be skipped once bfg_payouts is warm; currently the skeleton still shows because !instruments.length gates the render. Minor UX polish only.

ws_routes.py _settle_one persists the live payout back onto order.payout_pct even for lost/refunded outcomes — harmless (payout doesn't affect their math) but if the product wants the stored payout to reflect 'what would have been paid', current behaviour is correct. Confirm with product.

rca of the issue: Original 0% bug: socket 'markets/payouts' table was merged INTO the instruments state array. If the socket event arrived before /api/market/instruments HTTP resolved, setInstruments([...]) overwrote the payout entries with a stale HTTP list where payout is undefined -> Number(undefined) === NaN -> rendered as 0%. Fix (verified): a separate payouts state (initialized from bfg_payouts localStorage) is merged onto the instruments list at render time (instrumentList map at lines 271-273), so payout is always the freshest known value and never lost to a race. UI additionally shows an em-dash instead of a misleading 0% when payout is genuinely unknown (TradePanel.jsx lines 125-127, AssetPicker.jsx line 60).
